    List<CausalPosition>
    CausalDependencies.findMissing(CausalFrontier frontier)
    Returns the causal gap between these dependencies and frontier: for every position where these dependencies require a higher offset than the frontier has observed, the result contains a CausalPosition with the shortfall (required − observed, counting an absent frontier position as -1 so the gap is required + 1).
    boolean
    CausalDependencies.isSatisfiedBy(CausalFrontier frontier)
    Returns true if frontier has observed at least everything these dependencies require — for every position in these dependencies, the frontier's observed offset is ≥ the required offset.
